goal: Make parallel-workstream reservations authoritative from the integration base and machine-check actual worker diffs/dependencies without changing Architecture Baseline v1 semantics.
baseline_impact: none; post-Baseline concurrency/integration guard implementation only
acceptance: A parallel worker branch uses the deterministic workstream/<workstream-id> namespace and has exactly one matching active workstream manifest.
The workstream reservation must already exist on the PR/integration base; a worker cannot create or expand its own write authority in the same implementation change.
Actual changed paths on a worker branch are limited to the workstream's reserved exclusive_write_prefixes plus its own branch-local workstream control directory.
Active workstream dependencies must exist and be acyclic; ready_for_integration workstreams may depend only on integrated/closed prerequisites.
Worker branch pushes receive the Architecture Baseline/workstream boundary gate, while final shared/main integration remains serialized.
Architecture Baseline v1 invariants and Capability Registry semantic ownership remain unchanged.
